title: Spec check report shape rejects a capitalised item id (S374 for s374)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ork run slicer s374 and s375 failed the spec check twice in a row ('report shape: a section for S374, which is not in the batch; no section for s374'); s444 hit the same on 2026-11-07. The spec-check agent writes the id capitalised and the validator compares exactly. Fix: match ids case-insensitively and map back, and/or put the exact id in the report template. Each failure costs two agent calls and blocks the slice's start. Seen on build 1dc159d0; check whether 3d537be3 still does it.
